designer_statement_note: The rulebook itself is the designer's own primary statement of the rules (Patrick Todoroff writing in first person throughout, including sidebar design-intent notes e.g. on Powered Weapons and on keeping rules light in Part 11).

extraction_method.reason: Clean embedded text layer confirmed on every page (no OCR fallback needed).
extraction_method.encoding_check: Full extraction scanned for U+FFFD (replacement character): 0 found across all 65 pages. The non-ASCII characters present are legitimate typographic Unicode already correctly decoded by PyMuPDF (right/left single and double smart quotes U+2019/U+2018/U+201D/U+201C, en dash U+2013, ellipsis U+2026, bullet U+2022, copyright sign U+00A9, e-acute U+00E9, no-break space U+00A0, narrow no-break space U+202F). See research/captures/zona-alfa/extraction_report.json for the full inventory. The 'that turn?s Initiative'-style corruption flagged in the pre-extraction probe did not reproduce with fitz — see the wargaming-researcher session notes for the friction writeup.
